y-m-17-04.title: Ukuze kwabiwe izimbumbulu ngesilinganiso 3 : 2, inani eliphelele kufanele libe njani?
y-m-17-04.topic: Ukwabela ngokulinganayo: ukuhlukanisa ngesilinganiso nemibandela yenani eliphelele
y-m-17-04.goal: Hlola isimangalo esithi 'uma isamba siyinombolo engaphindwayo, asikwazi ukwabiwa 3 : 2' ngesibonelo esiphikisayo, bese uthola umbandela wenani eliphelele lapho lingabiwa ngesilinganiso.
y-m-17-04.material: Ufuna ukufaka izimbumbulu eBhokisini 가 neBhokisini 나. Isilinganiso senani lezimbumbulu emabhokisini amabili kumele sibe ngu-3 : 2, izimbumbulu azikwazi ukuhlukaniswa zibe izingcezu, futhi womabili amabhokisi athola okungenani isimbumbulu esi-1. U-Yuri uthe, “Uma inani eliphelele lezimbumbulu lingaphindwayo, awukwazi ukulabela 3 : 2. Inombolo engaphindwayo ayikwazi ukwabiwa ngokulinganayo!”
y-m-17-04.prereq.0: Incazelo yesilinganiso 3 : 2 (uma uhlangothi olulodwa lungamaqembu ama-3, olunye lungamaqembu ama-2)
y-m-17-04.s.s1.prompt: Iyiphi indlela efaneleka kakhulu yokuhlola ukuthi isimangalo sika-Yuri silungile yini?
y-m-17-04.s.s1.hint.0: Qala ngokubheka ukuthi isitatimende sika-Yuri sithi 'njalo' noma sithi 'kwamanye amacala.'
y-m-17-04.s.s1.hint.1: Qala ngo-3 ebhokisini elilodwa bese unquma elinye ibhokisi ugcina isilinganiso. Hlola ukuthi isamba siyinombolo engaphindwayo noma iphindwayo.
y-m-17-04.s.s1.o.a: Inombolo engaphindwayo ayikwazi ukwabiwa ngokulinganayo, ngakho sho ngokushesha ukuthi kulungile
y-m-17-04.s.s1.r.a: 3 : 2 akukhona ukwabela ngokulinganayo. Hlukanisa 'ukwabela ngokulinganayo' no-'ukwabela ngesilinganiso.'
y-m-17-04.s.s1.o.b: Funa icala elilodwa lapho isamba singaphindwayo futhi sihlukaniseka 3 : 2
y-m-17-04.s.s1.r.b: Isitatimende sokuthi 'asisebenzi nanini' siphulwa icala elilodwa elisebenzayo. Uzama ukuthola isibonelo esinjalo.
y-m-17-04.s.s1.o.c: Zama ukwabela izimbumbulu ezingu-7 ezingaphindwayo 3 : 2, futhi uma kungasebenzi, sho ukuthi u-Yuri ulungile
y-m-17-04.s.s1.r.c: Ukuthi u-7 awusebenzi akusho ukuthi ezinye izinombolo ezingaphindwayo azisebenzi. Icala elilodwa elehlulekile alikwazi ukukhuluma 'ngazo zonke izinombolo ezingaphindwayo.'
y-m-17-04.s.s1.o.d: Sho ukuthi awukwazi ukuhlola ngoba awazi inani lezimbumbulu
y-m-17-04.s.s1.r.d: Ungamisa inani lezimbumbulu bese uhlola. Udinga nje ukuzama izinombolo eziningana.
y-m-17-04.s.s1.explain: Isimangalo sokuthi 'azikho izinombolo ezingaphindwayo ezisebenzayo' siphulwa ngokuthola nje inombolo eyodwa engaphindwayo ehlukaniseka 3 : 2. Ukuthola izinombolo eziningi ezingaphindwayo ezingasebenzi, njengo-7, akuqinisekisi ukuthi isimangalo silungile.
y-m-17-04.s.s2.prompt: Yenza izibonelo ezimbili ezihlukene ezikhombisa ukuthi isimangalo sika-Yuri asilungile. Isamba siyinani elingaphindwayo lezimbumbulu, 가 : 나 = 3 : 2, futhi isamba singu-100 noma ngaphansi.
y-m-17-04.s.s2.hint.0: Zama izimbumbulu ezi-3 eBhokisini 가 nezi-2 eBhokisini 나. Thola nezinye izinombolo lapho isilinganiso singu-3 : 2, bese uqhathanisa ukuthi isamba siyinombolo engaphindwayo noma iphindwayo.
y-m-17-04.s.s2.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi isamba siyinombolo engaphindwayo noma iphindwayo uma iqembu elilodwa lingumbumbulu o-1 nalapho lingu-2, bese ukhetha usayizi weqembu onika isamba esingaphindwayo.
y-m-17-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Izimbumbulu azikwazi ukuhlukaniswa, futhi womabili amabhokisi kumele abe nokungenani o-1.
y-m-17-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Isilinganiso sezinombolo asiyona u-3 : 2. Hlola ukuthi, uma 가 enamaqembu ama-3, 나 inamaqembu ama-2 yini.
y-m-17-04.s.s2.fail.c3: Isamba siyinani eliphindwayo lezimbumbulu. Kumele kube yisibonelo lapho isamba singaphindwayo.
y-m-17-04.s.s2.explain: isib. (3, 2) inesamba esingu-5, (9, 6) inesamba esingu-15, futhi (15, 10) inesamba esingu-25, konke kungaphindwayo. Uma iqembu elilodwa lingu-1, 3, noma 5 izimbumbulu, isamba sikhula sibe ngu-5, 15, 25…. Uma iqembu elilodwa liyinani eliphindwayo lezimbumbulu (2, 4…), isamba siyaphindwa.
y-m-17-04.s.s2.because.prompt: Uzothini ku-Yuri? Chaza usebenzisa izibonelo owazenza, bese ubhala icala elilodwa, uma likhona, lapho kungaphindwayo futhi kungenakwabiwa 3 : 2.
y-m-17-04.s.s2.because.hint.0: Ungathatha izinombolo ezibonelweni zakho ezimbili njengoba zinjalo. Qala ngokubhala izinombolo emabhokisini amabili, bese uhlola isamba.
y-m-17-04.s.s2.because.hint.1: Qala ngokubhala ngomusho owodwa ukuthi yiliphi ingxenye yesitatimende sika-Yuri elingalungile.

y-m-17-04.s.s2.because.model.0: Cha. Uma kunezimbumbulu ezingu-15, ukufaka u-9 eBhokisini 가 no-6 eBhokisini 나 kunika u-9 : 6 = 3 : 2, futhi u-15 ungaphindwayo. Inombolo engaphindwayo engeyona okuphindwe ngo-5, njengo-7, ayikwazi ukwabiwa 3 : 2.
y-m-17-04.s.s2.because.model.1: Nakuba ungaphindwayo, u-5 ungakwazi ukwabiwa abe ngu-3 no-2, ngakho isitatimende sika-Yuri asilungile. Isamba kumele sibe okuphindwe ngo-5 nje, njengo-5, 15, 25.
y-m-17-04.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Ngishiye isibonelo senombolo engaphindwayo engasebenzi, kodwa izibonelo eziphikisayo zanele.
y-m-17-04.s.s3.prompt: Kunani eliphelele lezimbumbulu ezingabiwa 3 : 2? Khetha zonke izinombolo ezingabiwa. (Izimbumbulu azikwazi ukuhlukaniswa zibe izingcezu, futhi womabili amabhokisi athola okungenani o-1.)
y-m-17-04.s.s3.hint.0: Kukho konke ukukhetha, hlola ukuthi isamba singahlukaniswa ngokulinganayo sibe amaqembu amaningi njengesamba sesilinganiso.
y-m-17-04.s.s3.hint.1: Ezinombolweni ocabanga ukuthi zingabiwa, bhala ngempela izinombolo ze-가 ne-나 bese uhlola ukuthi isilinganiso singu-3 : 2.
y-m-17-04.s.s3.r.a: Bheka ukuthi uhlukanise izimbumbulu ezingu-35 zibe amabhokisi amabili bese uhlola isilinganiso.
y-m-17-04.s.s3.r.b: U-42 uyaphindwa, kodwa akusebenzi ngoba nje uyaphindwa. Wabele 3 : 2 bese uhlola ukuthi inombolo ebhokisini ngalinye iyinombolo yemvelo yini.
y-m-17-04.s.s3.r.c: Bheka ukuthi uhlukanise izimbumbulu ezingu-40 zibe amabhokisi amabili bese uhlola isilinganiso.
y-m-17-04.s.s3.r.d: Wabele izimbumbulu ezingu-48 3 : 2 bese uhlola ukuthi ibhokisi elilodwa liphuma njengenombolo yemvelo yini.
y-m-17-04.s.s3.r.e: Bheka ukuthi uhlukanise izimbumbulu ezingu-45 zibe amabhokisi amabili bese uhlola isilinganiso.
y-m-17-04.s.s3.explain: 3 : 2 kusho ukuhlukanisa isamba sibe amaqembu ama-5 futhi unikeze amaqembu ama-3 kolunye uhlangothi nama-2 kolunye, ngakho isamba kumele sibe okuphindwe ngo-5 nje. U-35 ungabiwa abe ngu-21 no-14, u-40 abe ngu-24 no-16, futhi u-45 abe ngu-27 no-18. U-42 no-48 ngeke bahlukaniswe ngokulinganayo bebe amaqembu ama-5.

y-m-17-09.title: Kungenziwa izinhlobo ezingaki zezinkomishi ngeshidi elilodwa lephepha?
y-m-17-09.topic: I-net ye-cylinder: inkomishi eyenziwa ngokugoqa iphepha
y-m-17-09.goal: Qinisekisa ukuthi izinkomishi ezahlukene ezimise okwe-cylinder zenziwa kuye ngokuthi iyiphi indlela eligoqwa ngayo iphepha eliyisikwele esinde, bese uthola kokubili ububanzi nobude ukuze ulungise iphutha esixazululweni.
y-m-17-09.material: Kunephepha eliyisikwele esinde elibanzi ngo-18.84 cm futhi lide ngo-31.4 cm. Ufuna ukugoqa lelo phepha bese uxhuma ukuphela okubili ukwenza inkomishi emise okwe-cylinder evulekile phezulu naphansi. Xhuma iphepha ngaphandle kokudlulana, futhi ungacabangi ngobukhulu bocingo. Sebenzisa u-3.14 ku-pi, futhi usebenzise iphepha njengesikwele esinde esiyiso.
y-m-17-09.thinking.0: Ukuthola izixazululo eziningana kucezu olulodwa lolwazi
y-m-17-09.thinking.2: Ukwenza ngaphandle kokushiya izimo ezanelisa izimo

y-m-17-09.prereq.1: Ukushintshana phakathi kobubanzi nomjikelezo ngo-pi njengo-3.14
y-m-17-09.s.s1.prompt: Zingaki izinhlobo zezinkomishi ezingenziwa ngeshidi elilodwa lephepha? Khetha umcabango ofaneleke kakhulu.
y-m-17-09.s.s1.hint.0: Cabanga isikwele esinde sigoqwe ngobubanzi baso nesigoqwe ngobude baso, bese usho ukuthi yiluphi uhlangothi olwakha indingilizi ngayinye.
y-m-17-09.s.s1.hint.1: Lapho ulugoqa ulixhuma, cabanga ukuthi ubude bohlangothi oluxhunyiwe bulingana yini nomjikelezo wendingilizi ephezulu yenkomishi.
y-m-17-09.s.s1.o.a: Eyodwa kuphela. Ngoba usayizi wephepha umisiwe
y-m-17-09.s.s1.r.a: Iphepha lingagoqwa ngobubanzi baso noma ngobude baso. Qala uhlole ukuthi isiqondiso sokugoqa nokuxhuma sinqunyiwe yini.
y-m-17-09.s.s1.o.b: Ezimbili. Kunezindlela ezimbili iphepha elingagoqwa ngazo
y-m-17-09.s.s1.r.b: Uthole ukuthi uhlangothi oluba ngumjikelezo luhluka kuye ngesiqondiso iphepha ligoqwa futhi lixhunywa ngaso.
y-m-17-09.s.s1.r.c: Umjikelezo unqunywa ubude bohlangothi lwephepha. Uma ukhetha ububanzi ngokukhululekile, iphepha lizoba mfushane noma lisale.
y-m-17-09.s.s1.r.d: Inkomishi ingenziwa nangeshidi eliyisikwele esinde. Udinga nje ukunquma ukuthi yiluphi uhlangothi ozolusebenzisa njengomjikelezo.
y-m-17-09.s.s1.explain: Ubude bohlangothi oluxhunyiwe lapho iphepha ligoqwa buba ngumjikelezo wesisekelo. Ungalugoqa ngobubanzi obungu-18.84 cm njengomjikelezo, noma ngobude obungu-31.4 cm njengomjikelezo. Ngakho kwenziwa izinkomishi ezimbili ezihlukile.
y-m-17-09.s.s2.prompt: UJia uchaze inkomishi eyenziwe ngokugoqa ngohlangothi olungu-18.84 cm njengomjikelezo kanje. Khetha umugqa ongalungile.
y-m-17-09.s.s2.hint.0: Phawula ukuthi yiluphi uhlangothi lwephepha olusetshenziswe njengomjikelezo nokuthi yiluphi njengobude, bese uhlola ukuthi uhlangothi olufanayo lusetshenziswe kabili yini.
y-m-17-09.s.s2.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi izinhlangothi ezimbili ezingaxhunyiwe ziba imiphetho ephezulu nephansi yenkomishi lapho iphepha ligoqwa yini.
y-m-17-09.s.s2.line.0: Uma iphepha ligoqwa ngobubanzi baso, u-18.84 cm uba ngumjikelezo wesisekelo.
y-m-17-09.s.s2.line.1: Umjikelezo = ububanzi × 3.14, ngakho ububanzi bungu-18.84 ÷ 3.14 = 6 cm.
y-m-17-09.s.s2.line.2: Kulesi simo ubude benkomishi bungobunye ubude bephepha, 18.84 cm.
y-m-17-09.s.s2.explain: Umugqa 3 awulungile. Njengoba uhlangothi olungu-18.84 cm lube ngumjikelezo wesisekelo, ubude benkomishi bungobunye ubude bephepha, 31.4 cm. Ubude obufanayo abungasetshenziswa kuzo zombili umjikelezo nobude. Umjikelezo emugqeni 1 nobubanzi obungu-6 cm emugqeni 2 kulungile.

y-m-17-09.s.s3.hint.0: Khetha uhlangothi olulodwa ozolusebenzisa njengomjikelezo bese uthola ububanzi kusukela ebudeni balolo hlangothi. Cabanga ukuthi uhlangothi olusele lube yiliphi ingxenye yenkomishi.
y-m-17-09.s.s3.hint.1: Khetha olunye uhlangothi njengomjikelezo bese wenza enye ngendlela efanayo, bese uhlola ukuthi izinkomishi ezimbili ziyahluka.
y-m-17-09.s.s3.fail.c1: Ububanzi nobude kumele kube kukhulu kuno-0.
y-m-17-09.s.s3.ok.c2: Uhlangothi olulodwa lwephepha luba ngumjikelezo nolunye uhlangothi luba bubude.
y-m-17-09.s.s3.fail.c2: Ububanzi nobude abuhambisani nenkomishi eyenziwe kusukela kulelophepha. Nquma ukuthi uhlangothi olusetshenziswa njengomjikelezo lungu-18.84 cm noma 31.4 cm, bese uhlola ukuthi olunye uhlangothi lusetshenziswa njengobude.
y-m-17-09.s.s3.explain: Uma ugoqa ngo-18.84 cm njengomjikelezo, ububanzi bungu-18.84 ÷ 3.14 = 6 cm futhi ubude bungu-31.4 cm. Uma ugoqa ngo-31.4 cm njengomjikelezo, ububanzi bungu-31.4 ÷ 3.14 = 10 cm futhi ubude bungu-18.84 cm. Zikhona lezi ezimbili kuphela.

y-m-17-12.title: Ithangi liphethe amanzi angu-0.048 L kuphela?
y-m-17-12.topic: Ukushintsha amayunithi evolumu: m³, cm³, L
y-m-17-12.goal: Thola iphutha esixazululweni esisebenzise ubudlelwano phakathi kwamayunithi obude ngqo kumayunithi evolumu, khetha indlela yokuhlola ukuthi umphumela uyaqondakala yini, bese ukubhala kabusha ngokulungile.
y-m-17-12.material: Kunethangi elinesimo sebhokisi elinxande. Lide ngo-1.2 m, libanzi ngo-0.8 m, liphakeme ngo-0.5 m, futhi cabanga ngaphakathi njengosayizi ofanayo. Lithatha ama-L amanzi amangaki uma ligcwaliswe ngaphezulu? USubin ulixazulule njengaphansi kodwa wezwa ukuthi impendulo ayinangqondo.
y-m-17-12.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa ophutha kusixazululo sikaSubin. (Izinombolo zemigqa ziqala ku-1.)
y-m-17-12.s.s1.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi ukuguqula ubude obungu-1 m bube ngu-100 cm kulungile yini, nokuthi ungayisebenzisa yini i-100 ngokufanayo uma uguqula ivolumu engu-1 m³.
y-m-17-12.s.s1.hint.1: Guqula ikhyubhu elinezinhlangothi ezingu-1 m libe ubude bohlangothi nge-cm bese uthola ivolumu yalo ngqo.
y-m-17-12.s.s1.line.3: 1 L = 1000 cm³, ngakho 48 cm³ = 0.048 L. Le nethangi lithatha amanzi angu-0.048 L.
y-m-17-12.s.s1.explain: Iphutha liqala emugqeni 2. 1 m ingu-100 cm, kodwa ivolumu engu-1 m³ ivolumu yekhyubhu elinezinhlangothi ezingu-1 m, ngakho ingu-100 × 100 × 100 = 1000000 cm³. Imigqa 3 no-4 iqhubekile nokuguqulwa okungalungile futhi yaba yizinani ezingalungile. Ukubala emugqeni 1 kulungile.
y-m-17-12.s.s2.prompt: Yiziphi izihlolo ezikusiza ukuthi ubone ukuthi umphumela kaSubin (0.048 L) awujwayelekile? Khetha zonke ezifanele.
y-m-17-12.s.s2.hint.0: Qhathanisa ngamazwi usayizi wethangi nosayizi webhokisi elilodwa lobisi (1 L).
y-m-17-12.s.s2.hint.1: Xazulula ngokulandelana okuhlukile kukaSubin (uguqula wonke ubude ube ngama-cm kusukela ekuqaleni) bese uhlola ukuthi imiphumela emibili iyafana.
y-m-17-12.s.s2.o.a: Cindezela ukubala okufanayo ku-calculator kanye futhi ubone ukuthi kuphuma inani elifanayo yini
y-m-17-12.s.s2.r.a: Uma ubala ngomcabango ofanayo, kuphuma inani elifanayo futhi. Ukuthi ukubala kulungile yini nokuthi ukuguqulwa kulungile yini kuyizinto ezahlukile.
y-m-17-12.s.s2.o.b: Qhathanisa usayizi wethangi nosayizi webhokisi lobisi elingu-1 L
y-m-17-12.s.s2.r.b: Uhlole ukuthi umphumela unengqondo yini ngokuqhathanisa nosayizi wento yangempela.
y-m-17-12.s.s2.o.c: Sula amayunithi bese uhlulela usayizi ngezinombolo kuphela
y-m-17-12.s.s2.r.c: Uma iyunithi ishintsha, inombolo efanayo iba usayizi ohluke ngokuphelele. Umnyombo wenkinga ukuthi iyunithi iphutha yini.
y-m-17-12.s.s2.o.d: Guqula wonke ubude ube ngama-cm kusukela ekuqaleni, uxazulule futhi, bese uqhathanisa
y-m-17-12.s.s2.r.d: Uxazulule futhi ngokulandelana okuhlukile futhi waqhathanisa imiphumela. Kuyikuhlola ukuthi inani lifana noma ngabe ukuguqulwa kwenziwa ngokulandelana kuni.
y-m-17-12.s.s2.explain: Uma ukhumbula ukuthi ithangi likhulu kakhulu kunebhokisi lobisi, noma uguqulela ku-cm kusukela ekuqaleni bese uqhathanisa ngokubala 120 × 80 × 50, ungasho ukuthi u-0.048 L awujwayelekile. Ukuphindaphinda ukubala okufanayo noma ukusula amayunithi akwambuli iphutha.
y-m-17-12.s.s3.prompt: Lungisa ukuguqulwa okungalungile kusixazululo sikaSubin bese uthola ukuthi lelithangi lithatha ama-L amanzi amangaki. Bhala nokuthi uyazi kanjani.
y-m-17-12.s.s3.hint.0: Njengoba 1 m ingu-100 cm, guqula uhlangothi lwekhyubhu elinezinhlangothi ezingu-1 m lube ngama-cm bese uthola ivolumu yalo.
y-m-17-12.s.s3.hint.1: Guqula ubude bokuqala bonke bube ngama-cm, uphindaphinde, bese uqhathanisa ukuthi ifana nenani olithole yini.
y-m-17-12.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ucabange ukuthi 1 m³ ikhyubhu elinezinhlangothi ezingu-100 cm?
y-m-17-12.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe wehlukanisile ukuthi uphindaphinde ngemva kokushintsha amayunithi noma washintsha amayunithi ngemva kokuphindaphinda?
y-m-17-12.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ucabange ukuthi u-480 L owuthole unengqondo yini?
y-m-17-12.s.s3.model.0: 1 m³ ikhyubhu elinezinhlangothi ezingu-100 cm, ngakho ingu-100 × 100 × 100 = 1000000 cm³. Ngakho 0.48 m³ ingu-480000 cm³, futhi 1000 cm³ ingu-1 L, ngakho ingu-480 L.
y-m-17-12.s.s3.model.1: Ungaguqulela futhi ku-cm kusukela ekuqaleni ubale 120 × 80 × 50 = 480000 cm³. Ukubhala 1 m³ = 100 cm³ kwakuyiphutha lokusebenzisa ubude obungu-100 nakwivolumu. 480000 cm³ ÷ 1000 = 480 L.

y-m-17-11.s.s1.hint.1: Ushintsha inani lezinhlangothi zesisekelo, thola izimo lapho kunemiphetho engu-24, ezi-prism nezi-pyramid ngokwehlukana.
y-m-17-11.s.s1.o.a: Yebo, ingenziwa yaba yinye. Iyi-octagonal prism
y-m-17-11.s.s1.r.a: Ucabange kuphela ngezi-prism futhi awuhlolanga ukuthi i-pyramid nayo ingaba nemiphetho engu-24 yini.
y-m-17-11.s.s1.o.b: Yebo, ingenziwa yaba yinye. Iyi-dodecagonal pyramid
y-m-17-11.s.s1.r.b: Ucabange kuphela ngezi-pyramid futhi awuhlolanga ukuthi i-prism nayo ingaba nemiphetho engu-24 yini.
y-m-17-11.s.s1.o.c: Cha, ayikwazi ukwenziwa yaba yinye. Kokubili i-prism ne-pyramid kungaba nemiphetho engu-24
y-m-17-11.s.s1.r.c: Ucabange kokubili izi-prism nezi-pyramid futhi wanquma ukuthi akunqunyiwe kube kunye.
y-m-17-11.s.s1.o.d: Cha, ayikwazi ukwenziwa yaba yinye. Inani lemiphetho lihluka kusimo ngasinye, ngakho alinakuba ngumkhondo
y-m-17-11.s.s1.r.d: Inani lemiphetho linqunywa yinani lezinhlangothi zesisekelo. Lingaba ngumkhondo, kodwa alanele lodwa.
y-m-17-11.s.s1.explain: I-prism enesisekelo esinezinhlangothi ezingu-8 (i-octagonal prism) inemiphetho engu-24, futhi i-pyramid enesisekelo esinezinhlangothi ezingu-12 (i-dodecagonal pyramid) nayo inemiphetho engu-24. Ngakho lo mkhondo wodwa awukwazi ukunquma kube kunye.
y-m-17-11.s.s2.prompt: Thola zonke izimo eziqinile ezinemiphetho engu-24 bese uzibhala njengezimpendulo ezihlukile. Bhala inani lezinhlangothi zesisekelo njengo-n, futhi ubhale uhlobo t njengo-1 ku-prism no-2 ku-pyramid.
y-m-17-11.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala ukuthi imiphetho ye-prism ibalwa kanjani usebenzisa inani lezinhlangothi zesisekelo, bese uthola inani lezinhlangothi elinikeza u-24.
y-m-17-11.s.s2.hint.1: Bala imiphetho ye-pyramid ngendlela efanayo, thola inani lezinhlangothi elinikeza u-24, bese uhlola ukuthi lisimo esiqinile esihlukile ku-prism engenhla.
y-m-17-11.s.s2.ok.c1: Isisekelo sinenani lemvelo lezinhlangothi elingu-3 noma ngaphezulu.
y-m-17-11.s.s2.fail.c1: Isisekelo kumele sibe yi-polygon enezinhlangothi ezingu-3 noma ngaphezulu.
y-m-17-11.s.s2.fail.c3: Akunemiphetho engu-24. Bhala inani lemiphetho yohlobo olukhethile ngokuya ngenani lezinhlangothi zesisekelo bese uhlola.
y-m-17-11.s.s2.explain: Zi-octagonal prism enezinhlangothi zesisekelo ezingu-8 (imiphetho engu-8 esisekelweni esisodwa + imiphetho engu-8 kolunye isisekelo + imiphetho engu-8 yohlangothi = 24) ne-dodecagonal pyramid enezinhlangothi zesisekelo ezingu-12 (imiphetho yesisekelo engu-12 + imiphetho yohlangothi engu-12 = 24). Lezi ezimbili kuphela.
y-m-17-11.s.s3.prompt: Uma wengeza umkhondo owodwa kuphela kulo mlolozelo, yiziphi ezingakuvumela ukunquma isimo esiqinile kube sesisodwa? Khetha zonke.
y-m-17-11.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala inani lama-vertex, inani lobuso, nesimo sobuso bohlangothi sezinketho ezimbili ethebuleni, bese uthola lapho ababili behluke khona.
y-m-17-11.s.s3.hint.1: Ekhethweni ngalunye, hlola ukuthi izinketho ezimbili banenani elifanayo noma elihlukile.
y-m-17-11.s.s3.r.a: Lokhu ukucabanga kokubala ama-vertex esimo ngasinye ukuhlola ukuthi lingahlukanisa izinketho ezimbili yini.
y-m-17-11.s.s3.r.b: Ubude bungaba ngu-5 cm kubo zombili izinketho.
y-m-17-11.s.s3.r.c: Bobabili abaqokeleli banesisekelo esiyi-polygon. Yisimo esesivele sinikeziwe enkingeni.
y-m-17-11.s.s3.r.d: Lokhu ukucabanga kokuhlola ukuthi isimo sobuso bohlangothi sihluka phakathi kwizinketho ezimbili yini.
y-m-17-11.s.s3.r.e: Lokhu ukucabanga kokubala ubuso besimo ngasinye ukuhlola ukuthi lingahlukanisa izinketho ezimbili yini.
y-m-17-11.s.s3.explain: I-octagonal prism inama-vertex angu-16 nobuso obungu-10, futhi ubuso bayo bohlangothi buyizikwele ezinde. I-dodecagonal pyramid inama-vertex angu-13 nobuso obungu-13, futhi ubuso bayo bohlangothi bungonxantathu. Ama-vertex angu-16, ubuso bonke bohlangothi bungonxantathu, nobuso obungu-13 kungahlukanisa ababili, kodwa ubude noma ‘isisekelo siyi-polygon’ akunakwenza.

y-m-17-01.title: Kufanele ngidwebe ubude obungakanani be-3 km emephini?
y-m-17-01.topic: I-scale: isilinganiso sobude emephini nobude bangempela
y-m-17-01.goal: Sebenza ukuthi i-scale ixhuma kanjani ubude emephini nobude bangempela ukuze uthole iphutha esixazululweni, bese wenza amabhanqa amaningana (ubude emephini, i-scale) ahambisana nobude bangempela obufanayo.
y-m-17-01.material: Ufuna ukudweba indlela yokuhamba phambi kwesikole emephini. Ngezansi kwemephu, i-scale '1 : 50000' (u-1 ku-50000) ibhalwe. Lokhu kusho ukuthi 1 cm emephini ungu-50000 cm empilweni yangempela, futhi yonke imephu inciphisiwe ngesilinganiso esifanayo. U-1 km ungu-100000 cm. UMina uxazulule 'Kufanele ngidwebe ama-cm amangaki emephini endleleni engempela ye-3 km?' njengoba kungezansi.
y-m-17-01.thinking.1: Ukukhetha izindlela zokuhlola ukuthi umphumela uyaqondakala yini
y-m-17-01.prereq.0: Ukwazi ukuthi i-scale (isb. 1 : 50000) iyisilinganiso sobude emephini nobude bangempela
y-m-17-01.prereq.1: Ubudlelwano phakathi kwamayunithi obude (1 km = 100000 cm)
y-m-17-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa wokuqala ongalungile esixazululweni sikaMina.
y-m-17-01.s.s1.hint.0: Bheka umphumela kuqala. Kulungile yini ukuthi ubude bokudweba emephini buba bude kakhulu kunobude bangempela obungu-300000 cm?
y-m-17-01.s.s1.hint.1: Sebenzisa incazelo ye-scale, '1 cm emephini ungu-50000 cm empeleni,' njengoba injalo, bese ubhala ngokulandelana ukuthi 2 cm no-3 cm emephini mangaki ama-cm empeleni.
y-m-17-01.s.s1.line.1: 1 cm emephini ungu-50000 cm empilweni yangempela, ngakho (ubude emephini) = (ubude bangempela) × 50000.
y-m-17-01.s.s1.line.3: Ngakho indlela kufanele idwetshwe emephini ngo-15000000000 cm.
y-m-17-01.s.s1.explain: Iphutha liqala emugqeni 2. I-scale 1 : 50000 isho ukuthi ubude bangempela buyizikhathi ezingu-50000 zobude emephini, ngakho ukuthola ubude emephini kumele wehlukanise ubude bangempela ngo-50000, hhayi ukuphindaphinda ngo-50000. Ukubala emugqeni 3 kulandela umugqa 2 ngakho ukubala ngokwako kulungile kodwa umphumela uyinqaba, futhi umugqa 4 awulungile ngesizathu esifanayo. Kuxazululwe ngokulungile, kudwetshwa ngo-6 cm emephini.
y-m-17-01.s.s2.prompt: Yiziphi izinhlolo ezikusiza uqaphele ukuthi umphumela kaMina uyinqaba? Khetha zonke ezifanele.
y-m-17-01.s.s2.hint.0: Ekhethweni ngalunye, qhathanisa ‘lolu hlolo lungakuvumela ukuthi wazi ukuthi ukucabanga akulungile, noma lubuye lubuyalele ukucabanga okufanayo?’
y-m-17-01.s.s2.hint.1: Guqula u-15000000000 cm uMina athole wona ube ngama-km, bese ucabanga ukuthi ubude obungadwetshwa emephini eyodwa yini.
y-m-17-01.s.s2.o.a: Cindezela ukubala okufanayo ekhalkhulethara kanye futhi ukuze ubone ukuthi kuphuma inani elifanayo nelokuqala yini
y-m-17-01.s.s2.r.a: Uma ubala ngokucabanga okufanayo, inani elifanayo liphinde liphume. Ukuthi ukubala kulungile yini nokuthi ukucabanga (isibalo) kulungile yini yizinto ezihlukile.
y-m-17-01.s.s2.o.b: Inombolo inkulu kakhulu, ngakho ukubhala nje iyunithi nge-km kwenza kube inani elilungile
y-m-17-01.s.s2.r.b: Uma ushintsha kuphela iyunithi, inombolo oyibhalayo iyashintsha kodwa ubude buhlala bunjalo. U-15000000000 cm ungu-150000 km, obude kakhulu ukudwetshwa emephini.
y-m-17-01.s.s2.o.c: Bhala ngokulandelana ukuthi 1 cm, 2 cm, no-3 cm emephini mangaki ama-cm angempela
y-m-17-01.s.s2.r.c: Uma uchaza incazelo ye-scale emshweni, ungabona ukuthi isiphi isiqondiso esikhulu.
y-m-17-01.s.s2.o.d: Sebenzisa umqondo ojwayelekile ukubuza ukuthi ubude obudwetshwe emephini bungaba bude kuno ubude bangempela yini
y-m-17-01.s.s2.r.d: Uhlola ukuthi umphumela uyaqondakala yini ngombono oyisisekelo wokuthi imephu iyidrowingi encishisiwe yento yangempela.
y-m-17-01.s.s2.explain: Uma uchaza incazelo ye-scale njengo-1 cm → 50000 cm no-2 cm → 100000 cm, noma ubheka umphumela ngomqondo ojwayelekile wokuthi imephu kumele ibe incane kunenyama, ungabona ukuthi isiqondiso sokuphindaphinda asilungile. Ukwenza ukubala okufanayo futhi kungaphinda iphutha elifanayo.
y-m-17-01.s.s3.prompt: Kulokhu, ucabanga kahle, ufuna ukudweba indlela engempela ye-2 km njengama-cm emephini (inombolo yemvelo kusuka ku-4 kuya ku-20). Yenza ama-scale ama-2 '1 : b' ongawasebenzisa, anobude obuhlukile emephini.
y-m-17-01.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ukhethe a, bese ucabanga ukuthi 1 cm emephini kumele ube ngama-cm angempela amangaki ukuze a cm engeze ku-200000 cm. Leli nani ngu-b.
y-m-17-01.s.s3.hint.1: Ngemva kokukhetha a no-b, hlola emuva ukuthi a cm emephini aba ngu-200000 cm empeleni yini, bese uzama futhi ngo-a ohlukile.
y-m-17-01.s.s3.ok.c1: Ubude emephini buyinombolo yemvelo kusuka ku-4 cm kuya ku-20 cm.
y-m-17-01.s.s3.fail.c1: Ubude emephini a kumele bube yinombolo yemvelo kusuka ku-4 kuya ku-20.
y-m-17-01.s.s3.fail.c2: U-□ (b) we-scale kumele abe yinombolo yemvelo.
y-m-17-01.s.s3.ok.c3: a cm emephini imele u-2 km wangempela (200000 cm).
y-m-17-01.s.s3.fail.c3: a cm emephini awubi ngu-200000 cm empeleni. Hlola futhi ukuthi 1 cm emephini ungama-cm angempela amangaki.
y-m-17-01.s.s3.explain: isb. Kwa-4 cm kungu-1 : 50000, kwa-5 cm kungu-1 : 40000, kwa-8 cm kungu-1 : 25000, futhi kwa-10 cm kungu-1 : 20000. Noma ngo-2 km ofanayo, uma uwudweba kude emephini, u-□ we-scale udinga ukuba mncane (imephu enemininingwane eminingi).

y-m-17-02.title: Uma usebenzisa ama-coupon amabili, kufana nesaphulelo se-30%?
y-m-17-02.goal: Hlola umbono wokuqala wokwengeza amazinga esaphulelo ngezibonelo zezinombolo, uvuselele isinqumo sakho nokuqiniseka kwakho isikhathi ngasinye lapho kuvela ulwazi olusha, bese uchaza ukuthi liyiphi izinga elikhulunywa ngalo iphesenti.
y-m-17-02.material: Isitolo se-inthanethi sinama-coupon amabili. I-coupon 가 ithi '20% ukuncipha entengweni yamanje' futhi i-coupon 나 ithi '10% ukuncipha entengweni yamanje,' futhi 가 no-나 kungasetshenziswa kokubili okukodwa ngemva kokunye. UMinseo uthe, "20% no-10% kufana no-30% ukuncipha ndawonye!" Izintengo ezibhalwe uhlu ziyizinombolo zemvelo (won) ezinkulu kuno-0, futhi sebenzisa kuphela izintengo eziphuma ncamashi nge-won.
y-m-17-02.thinking.2: Ukuhlunga lokho isibonelo esisodwa esikutshelayo nalokho esingakutsheli
y-m-17-02.prereq.0: Incazelo yephesenti (izinga lapho inani eliyisisekelo lingu-100)
y-m-17-02.prereq.1: Ukuthola intengo encishisiwe kusuka entengweni evamile nasezingeni lesaphulelo
y-m-17-02.s.s1.prompt: Hlola ukuthi isitatimende sikaMinseo silungile yini ngokukhetha umcabango wakho isikhathi ngasinye lapho kuvela ulwazi olusha.
y-m-17-02.s.s1.hint.0: Esinyathelweni ngasinye, hlukanisa ‘lokho ongakusho ngolwazi olwaziwa manje kuphela’ no-‘lokho ongakakwazi.’
y-m-17-02.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi umcabango owukhethile esinyathelweni sangaphambilini uhambisana kanjani nolwazi olusha, bese usho ukuthi ukuzethemba kwakho kukhule noma kwancipha.
y-m-17-02.s.s1.st.0.info: Intengo evamile ayikatshelwa. Kunesitatimende sikaMinseo kuphela nemithetho yama-coupon.
y-m-17-02.s.s1.st.0.ask: Khetha okuseduze kakhulu nalokho ukucabanga manje.

y-m-17-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Uqaphele ukuthi isisekelo sesaphulelo sesibili siyashintsha.

y-m-17-02.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Uma intengo evamile ingu-10000 won, amanani ayahluka, ngakho isitatimende sikaMinseo asigcini kulesi simo

y-m-17-02.s.s1.st.3.r.b: Ukhulume ngokucophelela ngaphandle kokwenza isiphetho esijwayelekile kusukela emphumeleni owodwa.

y-m-17-10.material: Kunethangi elimise okwe-rectangular prism. Ngaphakathi libanzi ngo-30 cm, lide ngo-20 cm, futhi liphakeme ngo-20 cm, futhi liphethe amanzi aze afike ebudeni obungu-10 cm. Lapho kufakwa itshe emanzini, amanzi enyuka ngangokuthi itshe likhipha. Itshe alimunci amanzi, futhi ubukhulu bezindonga zethangi abunakwa.
